# Fetch all pages of Spotify recommendations and count artist appearances
recommendations = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20  # use max to minimize pages; must still paginate all pages

while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page', page_index, 'len', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    recommendations.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('total_recommendations', len(recommendations))

from collections import Counter
artist_counter = Counter()
first_seen_order = {}

for idx, song in enumerate(recommendations):
    for a in song.get('artists', []):
        name = a.get('name')
        if name is None:
            continue
        artist_counter[name] += 1
        if name not in first_seen_order:
            first_seen_order[name] = idx  # first song index where it appeared

print('unique_artists', len(artist_counter))
print('artist_counter_sorted_by_count', sorted(artist_counter.items(), key=lambda x: (x[1], first_seen_order[x[0]]))[:20])

min_count = min(artist_counter.values())
least_artists = [name for name, cnt in artist_counter.items() if cnt == min_count]
# deterministic: choose one with smallest first_seen_order
least_artist = sorted(least_artists, key=lambda n: first_seen_order[n])[0]

print('min_count', min_count)
print('least_artists_candidates', sorted(least_artists, key=lambda n: first_seen_order[n]))
print('least_artist', least_artist)
